files.description: Frontend design system (v3): color tokens, typography, component inventory (Button, Card, Table, Sheet, Dialog, Badge, etc.), layout principles, voice/tone for UI copy. Reference for all frontend/UI changes.

Documentation style guide: writing for users (not implementers), cross-referencing, Mintlify components (Steps, Tabs, Cards, Accordions, callouts, diagrams), page structure by type (guides, concepts, overviews, references), FAQs, prerequisites, terminology consistency. Reference for all docs/ changes.

Backend code quality floor: error messages users can understand and no pointless 500s, explicit validation on every API input (length bounds, allowed characters), correct pagination when calling third-party APIs (app connections, secret syncs), avoiding deadlock conditions on a small connection pool (thread the transaction handle through every query inside a transaction, keep transactions short and free of network calls), and REST-aligned API interface design. A deliberately non-exhaustive minimum, not a complete standard. Reference for all backend/ changes.

What counts as a breaking change for self-hosted Infisical, grouped by category with real examples from past releases (removed or moved endpoints, response shape changes, stricter validation, changed defaults, tightened permissions, dropped columns, rolling-deploy incompatibility, env vars, audit log fields), the compatible alternative for each, and what a PR must include when a break is deliberate. Reference for all backend/ and backend-go/ changes.
